summary: Iteration 36 - Avatar Learning Orchestrator & Bug Fixes. 31/31 backend tests passed. All new avatar orchestrator endpoints working. Key verifications: 1) GET /api/avatar-orchestrator/avatars returns HeyGen avatars, 2) GET /api/avatar-orchestrator/voices returns HeyGen voices, 3) POST /api/avatar-orchestrator/generate-video endpoint exists and accepts requests, 4) GET /api/avatar-orchestrator/video-status/{id} returns video status, 5) POST /api/avatar-orchestrator/interactive-tutor returns Q&A response, 6) POST /api/avatar-orchestrator/generate-slides returns slide content, 7) POST /api/avatar-orchestrator/generate-assessment returns quiz questions, 8) POST /api/avatar-orchestrator/adaptive-rewrite returns rewritten content, 9) POST /api/avatar-orchestrator/translate-script translates teaching script, 10) POST /api/research/search now accepts JSON body (was broken - used query param), 11) CourseViewPage Video tab shows 'Generate Avatar Video' button for ALL users, 12) CourseViewPage Slides tab shows 'AI Generate Slides' button for ALL users.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed: research/search endpoint HTTPException was being caught by generic except block - now properly re-raises HTTPException
Avatar orchestrator properly integrated with HeyGen API (1281 avatars, 2386 voices available)
All AI endpoints use Emergent LLM Key for script generation, slides, Q&A, assessments
Video/Slides generation buttons now available for ALL users (not just teachers)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All avatar orchestrator endpoints are working. Key features: 1) HeyGen integration for avatar video generation (don't actually generate - costs credits), 2) Interactive tutor Q&A with lesson context, 3) Slide generation from lesson content, 4) Assessment/quiz generation, 5) Adaptive difficulty rewriting, 6) Multi-language script translation. The research/search endpoint was fixed to properly return 400 when query is missing (was returning 500 due to HTTPException being caught by generic except). CourseViewPage now shows Generate Avatar Video and AI Generate Slides buttons for ALL users.

avatar_orchestrator_avatars.details: GET /api/avatar-orchestrator/avatars returns list of HeyGen avatars with avatar_id, avatar_name, preview_url

avatar_orchestrator_voices.details: GET /api/avatar-orchestrator/voices returns list of HeyGen voices with voice_id, name, language, gender

avatar_orchestrator_generate_video.details: POST /api/avatar-orchestrator/generate-video endpoint exists and accepts requests (not actually tested to avoid HeyGen credits)

avatar_orchestrator_interactive_tutor.details: POST /api/avatar-orchestrator/interactive-tutor returns Q&A response with mode=interactive_tutor

avatar_orchestrator_generate_slides.details: POST /api/avatar-orchestrator/generate-slides returns array of slides with slide_number, title, content, notes

avatar_orchestrator_generate_assessment.details: POST /api/avatar-orchestrator/generate-assessment returns questions array with multiple_choice and short_answer types

avatar_orchestrator_adaptive_rewrite.details: POST /api/avatar-orchestrator/adaptive-rewrite returns updated_script for target difficulty level

research_search_fix.details: POST /api/research/search now accepts JSON body with query field (was broken - used query param). Returns 400 when query missing.

messages_endpoint.details: POST /api/messages endpoint exists and requires authentication

generate_avatar_video_button_for_all_use.details: CourseViewPage Video tab shows 'Generate Avatar Video' button for students (not just teachers)

ai_generate_slides_button_for_all_users.details: CourseViewPage Slides tab shows 'AI Generate Slides' button for students (not just teachers)

research_search_httpexception.issue: HTTPException was being caught by generic except block and re-raised as 500
research_search_httpexception.fix: Added 'except HTTPException: raise' before generic except to properly propagate HTTP errors
